header.name: Mixed signal Design
header.description: This course teaches mixed signal circuits, which are very important bolcks in many modern processors. It covers switched capacitor circuits, comparators, different types of DACs, nyquist and over sampling ADCs.
prerequisites_desirable: Any or all system design courses in ECE
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Any or all system design courses in ECE

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to design Switched Capacitor Circuits/Filters from given specifications

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to decide the class and design a DAC given the specifications

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to design a comparator

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to decide the class and design an ADC given the specifications

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: The course will not have any assignments. However, the students have to do a project individually or as a group of no more than three students. The project will demand use of cadence and/or Mentor Graphic tools. The project also includes three presentations of 15 to 20mts. duration during the course.

lecture_topics: DACs : Voltage and charge based DACs
Sigma delta DACs and interpolation filtering (9).
Sigma Delta ADC and decimation filters (9)

resources.title: Rudy Van de Plassche, “Integrated Analog-To-Digital and Digital-To-Analog Converters”, Springer-Science, 1994.
Phillip E. Allen and Douglas R. Holberg, “CMOS Analog Circuit Design”, Oxford University Press, Edition 3, 2013.
Roubik Gregorian and Gabor C. Temes, “Analog MOS Integrated Circuits for Signal Processing”, Wiley Student Edition, 2008.
Behzad Razavi, “Design of Analog CMOS Integrated Circuits”, McGraw Hill Education (India), 2002.
